indexes.//: RankingService.cityRank: equality on role plus a range on points. A range filter alongside an equality filter always needs a composite index — this is the one the aggregation introduced.
Leaderboard filtered to one sport, and Scout's default view.
Scout with the 'open to recruitment only' toggle on.
Recent activity feed and the per-athlete stat averages, which now order by recency before applying their limit.
The organizer's tournament list, newest first. Bracket slots need no index of their own — a bracket is at most 15 documents, read whole and ordered client-side.
Unread-notification lookups for the badge and 'mark all read'.

The super-admin overview's 'Recent activity' list: one user's notifications, newest first. Until the admin console existed nothing ordered this collection by time — the home-screen bell reads it unordered.

The admin console's report queue, newest first. Covers both tabs: the Open tab filters status == 'open', the Closed tab uses whereIn over the two closed values, and an 'in' filter uses the same index as an equality one. The duplicate-report check in the report sheet needs no index — equality-only queries are served by merging single-field indexes.
